prep: Make assets/_anchors/portrait_grey.webp locally (free): a greyscale copy of assets/_anchors/portrait.webp, made the same way as banner_grey.webp.
Create assets/_bakeoff/ with a .gdignore (like assets/_anchors/) so Godot skips bake-off images. Bake-off picks are for blind judging, not shipping. Candidates stay gitignored.
Check GET /docs (free) for createImage image_type 'art' and aspect 'ar_16_9' (key-art row).
Budget guard as in STYLE_BIBLE §3 rule 19: balance_before minus credits.available, plus the next call's cost, must stay under the hard cap.

budget.price_basis: 0.5 cr per image (createImage, generateWithStyle) and per removeBackground (studio/ludo-playbook.md §2)
budget.breakdown: 2 banners x (2 x 0.5 + 0.5 cutout) = 3.0; 6 portraits x 2 x 0.5 = 6.0; 1 vista x 2 x 0.5 = 1.0

assets.prompt: Cel-shaded key art of bright high fantasy: wide landscape vista seen from a high three-quarter angle like a strategy game camera, thick clean dark outline of even weight, flat saturated colours with one hard-edged shadow tone and one highlight tone, simple bold shapes and large readable forms, warm golden late-afternoon light from the upper left with long soft shadows, clear depth from foreground to middle ground to far distance, wordless pure pictorial image. Subject: A Stormherd fortress on a green upland fell in the middle ground: concentric rings of pale drystone walls around round stone huts with turf roofs, and one huge slate-grey storm cloud tethered above the fortress by heavy iron chains, lit from inside by cyan lightning. Through the open gate an army musters and spills down the hillside toward the viewer: shepherds in bright yellow oilskin coats carrying tall brass-hooked crooks, driving a flock of round slate-grey storm-cloud sheep with black faces and a few great storm rams with curled horns. Far in the distance across rolling golden hills stands a tall mountain whose upper half is drawn only as glowing white outline against the sky, under a huge low golden afternoon sun.
assets.note: World key-art vista: a fortress with an army mustering (director, 2026-10-04). Uses the PROPOSED C-keyart block (the bible has no key-art class yet; art lead owns adding it). Text-only createImage, because no same-class anchor exists. Before sending, confirm on GET /docs (free) that createImage takes image_type 'art' and aspect 'ar_16_9'; otherwise use 'ar_4_3', then 'ar_1_1' and crop to 16:9.
assets.gates: Fortress, tethered cloud and mustering flock all read at 960x540; yellow oilskins and cyan lightning visible at 480x270; Noonmark mountain outline legible; wordless, invented heraldry.
